description.sr: Spisak studenata na poseti udruženju 30.10.2026. poslala je mejlom istog dana jedna od učesnica posete, uz Drive folder sa šest fotografija koje su snimili studenti (14:03–14:11); nastavnik ga je 31.10.2026. zaveo kao spisak i materijal posete petog časa. Redosled spiska je kako je poslat. Imena su upisana sa dijakritikom i oblikom koji za isti broj indeksa već stoji u registru; tri broja indeksa se ovde javljaju prvi put. Fotografije su prevedene iz HEIC u JPG bez metapodataka; originali se čuvaju sa otiskom.
description.en: The list of students on the association visit of 30 October 2026 was sent by email the same day by one of the visit’s participants, with a Drive folder of six photographs taken by students (14:03–14:11); the teacher filed it on 31 October 2026 as the visit list and material of the fifth class. The list order is as sent. Names are written with the diacritics and the form already standing in the register for the same student number; three student numbers appear here for the first time. The photographs were converted from HEIC to JPG without metadata; the originals are kept with fingerprints.

summary.sr: Treća poseta udruženju sa prototipima, u petak 30.10.2026, istog dana kad je održan peti čas. Na spisku posete su trideset četiri studenta; devetnaest od njih ima rad zaveden na spisku petog časa, a petnaest dolazi bez rada zavedenog tog dana. Šest fotografija posete snimili su studenti; na dve je prepoznat rad sa spiska petog časa (tabla sa kanapom i tabla sa oblicima), a na jednoj i list sa tačkama čiji autor još nije zaveden. Analiza po radu piše se kad stignu i preostali kadrovi.
summary.en: The third association visit with prototypes, on Friday 30 October 2026, the same day as the fifth class. Thirty-four students stand on the visit list; nineteen of them have a work filed on the fifth-class list, and fifteen come without a work filed that day. Six photographs of the visit were taken by students; two show a work recognised from the fifth-class list (the cord board and the shape board), and one also shows the dot sheet whose maker is not yet recorded. The per-work analysis is written when the remaining frames arrive.
